s: Ships every log line to searchable indexed storage with retention tiers - forensics backbone.
w: Agents (filebeat/fluentbit) tail files/containers, enrich (pod/service labels), ship to ingest pipelines; parsers structure JSON/plain lines; indexes make them searchable. Hot/warm/cold tiers balance cost; lifecycle policies expire old indices. Query languages (Lucene/Datadog-LQL) support ad-hoc investigation plus saved dashboards.
use: Incident forensics grepping exact error contexts across services
avoid: Precise numeric SLIs (metrics do aggregation math better)
Request journey visualization (tracing correlates spans better)
Keeping everything forever at hot tier (cost explodes - tier it)
pits: Indexing everything at hot tier melts budgets - sample debug logs, tier aggressively
tips: Structured JSON logging advocacy - makes every downstream tool smarter
